alternatives.option: Keep PROVEN_TABLE as the default and opt in per call site
alternatives.reason_rejected: Silent partial adoption; the assembler's hardcoded table_id proves the failure mode is real.

assumptions: The committed src/retrieval/calibration.json is the genuine output of scripts/calibrate-tokenizer.mjs against a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — its numbers were not re-derived here, only validated for shape and range
A measured table still warrants conservative_fallback: true, because it is an empirical bound over a named corpus rather than a count
Breaking the packet token_usage shape (new table_provenance field) is acceptable on the v3 line, per the settled 'breaking behaviour is permitted on v3' decision
constraints: Could not run npm run build or touch plugin/ — verified dist and bundle carriage with a scratch outDir and an in-memory esbuild instead
No network: the measured ratios could not be re-verified against the count-tokens API
context: Wired src/retrieval/calibration.json into the tokenizer: ACTIVE_TABLE (measured, validated at load, proven fallback) is now the default for every estimate, packet and briefing. 2711 pass.
rationale: The alternative — keep PROVEN as the default and pass ACTIVE explicitly at call sites — would have left any missed call site silently 2.3x loose, and the assembler was already hardcoding PROVEN_TABLE.id into the receipt, which would have misreported the table in use. Making the default the active table means tsc and the test suite find every site. Measured effect on prose: 0.42-0.44 tokens/byte against the proven 1.0, so a 4000-token briefing budget buys ~2.3x the content it did on the merge commit. Packet token_usage gained table_provenance so a receipt can still tell a proof from a measurement.
summary: ACTIVE_TABLE (measured when valid, proven otherwise) is the DEFAULT table for estimate, estimateTokensConservative, buildPacket and measureEnvelope, and is what context-assembler reports as table_id
